items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Lester Young only in the interviewer's prose section ('Basie's a very lonely man on his band stand after having played with Lester Young...'). The interviewee does not mention Lester Young in their own spoken turns, nor do they describe a personal interaction or relationship

ctx.x: He was a tenor man in the band when I got there up in Chicago.

I'll tell you another reason the Douglas Brothers didn't go further. Later Tommy played with Duke Ellington and Buck stayed in Chicago and Bill and I worked together with Nat Towles before he was drafted into the service. The reason they didn't go further is they had that great love for Kansas City, they didn't care to go anywhere. There was no need to go any further; Kansas City was a great jazz center then. It hasn't been in thirty something years.
